 Your Halloween Horoscope Is Here 
 Your Halloween Horoscope Is Here 
 The stars are aligning to help you indulge your wildest desires under these spooky skies.
 By Stephanie N. Campos Published: Oct 29, 2026 Save Article Share Article Khadija Horton/Getty Images You know what’s scarier than Halloween this year? Running into your ex while dressed up as Kelly Clarkson and “Molly” the Bird . This Halloween, the stars are aligning to heighten your intuition and sensitivities and then thrust you face-to-face with your past. The day starts off with the Moon in Cancer gently connecting with Mercury retrograde in Scorpio, putting you in a reflective mood but also strengthening your psychic abilities. Act on your instincts and read in between the lines!
 Later in the day, the Moon in Cancer crashes into Venus Retrograde in Libra, stirring up battles in our closest relationships. While some might meet an ex or a friend they had a falling out with face-to-face while out and about celebrating, others might be in a more nostalgic headspace. It might feel easier to romanticize the past or give someone from your past or an ex a pass for bad behavior, so just make sure you aren’t ignoring your own needs and worthiness if that’s the case.
 This planetary pairing can also put you in an indulgent mood, which arrives right on time for snacking on tasty treats and your go-to candy bars. Before the night’s over, the Moon eventually enters Leo, reminding you that you are the star of your own life and very own telenovela. Let yourself take up space, center your joy, and let your inner teen call the shots—even if you might regret them later!

 Read your Halloween horoscope by zodiac sign:
 Aries 
 Your intuition reaches new heights and you’re able to sort through the bs—especially in your relationships. Some might need to call out an uncomfortable truth or patterns in a close connection while others could find themselves out and about and accidentally running into an ex! When you choose to confront whatever has been left unsaid, you’ll find yourself in a healthier dynamic and maybe even agreeing to one of the night’s most memorable couple costumes!
 Taurus 
 You’re in high demand tonight, but you can’t be in a million places at once! Deciding who to spend Halloween with is weighing heavy on your mind and you might need to let a few people down in the process. Whatever you do, don’t lean into people-pleasing tendencies and jam-pack your schedule with too many events! No one knows how to indulge quite like you and you deserve to slow down and enjoy yourself, and a few delicious treats along the way.
 Gemini 
 It’s time to let your inner hedonist shine! Find a costume that makes you feel alive, magnetic, and sexy af. You’re meant to stand out today and even attract a few jealous haters along the way. It’s not your fault that you’re looking good, feeling good, and attracting who and what you desire as a result. Give yourself permission to lean all the way in and experiment with whatever pleasure-seeking your heart desires!
 Cancer 
 The stars are aligning so you can put yourself first! You might feel like you’re drawing extra attention your way—and you are! You’re leading with your authenticity and your aura is operating at a frequency that’s drawing others in. Post your sexy selfie, text your crush, and take a risk in matters of the heart. (Your ex will definitely watch your Instagram story today, so curate your highlight reel accordingly!) You’re also confronting the past in ways that feel healing and help you remember how far you’ve come. Own your power!
 Leo 
 Your Ancestors are begging for your attention! Pay attention to your dreams first thing when you wake up in the morning—there are important signs, symbols, and synchronicities that are showing up and offering guidance and insight. If you wake up in a haze, don’t push yourself. You might also be sleepier than normal, which is totally normal for someone who's been in contact with the other realms! You might need a cat nap before you head out to party later tonight. You have a direct line to the Otherside so ask your Guides for advice and let them surprise you with how they show up for you.
 Virgo 
 Don’t break the bank trying to perfect your Halloween costume this year! You’re known to go above and beyond with your costumes and pay attention to every little detail, but you can still slay without spending half of your savings. Lean into your creative nature and build a costume by repurposing items you already own. Halloween shouldn’t be stressful or bring up fears of spending money! You’re already dealing with the very real fears that Venus retrograde brings, like running into people from high school or people you lost touch with!
 Libra 
 You’re turning heads and making people regret their decision to ever cross you! You’re one of the main characters under today’s skies and feeling extra confident. You might learn some news worth celebrating, reach a milestone you’ve been working toward, or win the best Halloween costume at work. Your job today is to take up space and give yourself permission to soak up all the doting compliments that come your way!
 Scorpio 
 No one has all the gossip quite like you today. You could be standing in line at the grocery store or pumping gas and the stranger next to you is confiding in you and telling you their life story. Even though others are opening up, be careful not to get too caught up gossiping because it can backfire. Your psychic abilities are also surging, allowing you to read people before they even open their mouths. Trust your instincts and, when in doubt, consult your tarot deck for further information!
 Sagittarius 
 It’s time to wear your heart on your sleeve! You like to keep things light and playful, but you’re ready to go all in with a new person in your life. Maybe you’re trying out your first couple costume with a lover or spending Halloween with a new friend. You’re feeling ready to practice being vulnerable and honest about your needs even if you feel exposed and raw in the process. Relationships can deepen today as you explore your shadow side with someone else.
 Capricorn 
 You want your Halloween to feel like a rom-com, and are eager to spend your evening with someone special. Do your best to live in the present moment and try not to get swept up with nostalgia or comparison. It’s easy to fixate an old relationship that still has its grasp around your heart. You might be the ex in someone else’s retrograde story and decide to contact an old lover. Old relationship wounds or patterns can also resurface, asking you to reflect, be accountable, and heal in new ways so you can open your heart to new, aligned connections.
 Aquarius 
 Halloween can feel like a chore sometimes, but it doesn’t have to! Your schedule and responsibility load is heavier than normal. While you love a good side quest and party, there are a few things you need to get done before you can clock out for the day. Don’t overbook yourself and don’t be afraid to set boundaries with others. You deserve to enjoy part of the day and don’t have to be everyone else’s savior. Make sure you carve out some time for fun in between your busy schedule.
 Pisces 
 You’re oozing sex appeal and living in the moment! Did someone say flirting with a stranger while in line outside a bar? Your odds of finding a hot and heavy Halloween hook-up are high. Let yourself enjoy your day, dance the night away, and let your sensuality attract those meant for you. When you let your inhibitions go and prioritize your joy and pleasure, you’re unstoppable.
